name: zanker-design-audit
description: Audit an existing product UI across hierarchy, affordances, consistency and accessibility.

workflow.instruction: Inventory key screens and user journeys; prioritize costly issues.
Inspect rendered screenshots and interaction patterns, not only JSX/CSS.
Link each issue to usability impact, evidence, severity and source location.
Separate aesthetic preferences from normatively required accessibility fixes.

fallback: Provide a heuristic review with explicitly limited confidence.
